result.topic_en: Euler reviews which double series of each order his two methods can sum, conjectures that all orders are summable, notes that higher orders lack more than one determination, and introduces a shorthand notation p^μ for the double sums.
result.transcription:
166 MEDITATIONES CIRCA

24. Prima methodus tantum pro ordinibus paribus vnius ſeriei in noſtra forma generali contentae ſummam praebuerat, quae poſito $m+n=2\mu$ ita ſe habebat

$\int\frac{1}{z^{\mu}}\left(\frac{1}{y^{\mu}}\right)=\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{1}{z^{\mu}}\cdot\int\frac{1}{z^{\mu}}+\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{1}{z^{2\mu}}.$

Nunc autem ope ſecundi methodi praeterea ex quovis ordine vnam ſeriem formae noſtrae ſummare valemus, atque adeo in ordine $m+n=6$ omnes has ſeries ſummare licuit. Exquo ſuſpicari licet, hanc ſummationem quoque in omnibus ordinibus ſuccedere, etiamſi ſecunda methodus negotium non penitus conficiat: plurimum autem iam praeſtitum cenſeri debet, quod ſi cuiusque ordinis vnica ſeries praeter binas memoratas vndecunque ſummari poſſet, inde ſtatim omnium reliquarum ſummas conſequi: Res quidem ita ſe habet in ordinibus hic euolutis; at ſi vlterius progrediamus, plures vna determinationes deficere deprehenduntur.

25. Quo autem clarius ratio aequationum, quas tam prima quam ſecunda methodus pro quolibet ordine ſuppeditat, perſpiciatur, formulas noſtras adhuc ſuccinctius ita repraeſentemus, vt pro ordine quocunque $m+n=\lambda$ loco $\int\frac{1}{z^{\mu}}\cdot\frac{1}{z^{\nu}}$ ſcribatur vel $p^{\mu}$ vel $p^{\nu}$, quippe quae duae formulae ob $\mu+\nu=\lambda$ pro aequiualentibus ſunt habendae. Similique modo
pro

items.quote: Exquo ſuſpicari licet, hanc ſummationem quoque in omnibus ordinibus ſuccedere, etiamſi ſecunda methodus negotium non penitus conficiat
items.english: From this one may suspect that this summation also succeeds in all orders, even though the second method does not completely accomplish the task.

items.quote: quod ſi cuiusque ordinis vnica ſeries praeter binas memoratas vndecunque ſummari poſſet, inde ſtatim omnium reliquarum ſummas conſequi: Res quidem ita ſe habet in ordinibus hic euolutis; at ſi vlterius progrediamus, plures vna determinationes deficere deprehenduntur.
items.english: That if, in each order, a single series besides the two mentioned could be summed by some means, the sums of all the rest would follow at once. This is indeed the case in the orders worked out here; but if we go further, more than one determination is found to be lacking.

items.quote: Quo autem clarius ratio aequationum, quas tam prima quam ſecunda methodus pro quolibet ordine ſuppeditat, perſpiciatur, formulas noſtras adhuc ſuccinctius ita repraeſentemus
items.english: So that the structure of the equations that both the first and the second method supply for any order may be seen more clearly, let us represent our formulas still more concisely.
